detail.abstract: In Pakistan, private medical schools have long been subject to extremely strict academic regulations but somehow neglected regarding their finances. After media reports of widespread tax evasion and regulatory non-compliance, especially report published in the 'Business Recorder' dated 25.07.2023, the Federal Tax Ombudsman (FTO) launched an Own Motion investigation under Section 9(1) of the FTO Ordinance, 2000 into the tax affairs of Multan Medical and Dental College (MMDC), Multan, marking a significant step toward transparency and accountability.

AI.tldr: 巴基斯坦私立医学院长期受到严格的学术监管，但财务方面却被忽视。在媒体报道广泛逃税和不合规行为（尤其是2023年7月25日《商业记录报》的报道）后，联邦税务监察专员根据2000年FTO条例第9(1)条对木尔坦医学与牙科学院启动了主动调查，标志着迈向透明度和问责制的重要一步。
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦私立医学院的税务合规与监管缺失问题，以及联邦税务监察专员主动调查如何推动透明度和问责制。
AI.motivation: 巴基斯坦私立医学院在学术方面受到严格监管，但其财务状况长期被忽视，导致普遍逃税和监管不合规现象，需要通过调查实现透明和问责。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管治理与问责理论，涉及税务合规、公共问责和监管透明度框架。
AI.method: 案例分析——以联邦税务监察专员对木尔坦医学与牙科学院的主动调查为对象，基于媒体报道和官方条例（FTO Ordinance, 2000）进行法律与政策分析。
AI.findings: 联邦税务监察专员依据2000年FTO条例第9(1)条发起主动调查，针对私立医学院的税务逃漏和违规行为，开启了对该领域财务透明度与问责的正式审查。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了关于监管盲区（学术监管严格但财务监管缺失）的治理理论，展示了主动调查机制在弥补监管漏洞中的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦乃至其他发展中国家私立教育机构的税务监管提供了实践参考，凸显了媒体监督与独立监察机构在推动公共问责中的价值。

title: Bridging the Digital Divide: A Policy Review of Digital Adoption Barriers Among Sri Lankan Small Medium Enterprises. (Policy insight paper)
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Bridging the Digital Divide: A Policy Review of Digital Adoption Barriers Among Sri Lankan Small Medium Enterprises. (Policy insight paper)
detail.abstract: One of the major components of Sri Lankan economy is Small Medium Enterprises due to its massive contribution of employment and value addition on GDP. However, despite the growing number of internet users and the use of various technological advancements, most SMEs in the country have remained limited to conducting only basic digital activities such as marketing and communication. The limited adoption of e-commerce systems, digital payments, and integrated business technologies restricts potential productivity improvements and slows progress toward Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 8 targets. Sri Lanka has well established legal frameworks and digital initiates but the implementation gasp still remains. Especially the gap between policy-level initiatives and enterprise-level adoption. Therefore, this policy insight paper examines barriers affecting SME digital transformation in Sri Lanka by considering technological, organizational, and environmental perspectives. The challenges that have been identified include lack of integration of technologies, inadequate digital capabilities, financial constraints, trust issues, and lack of information on informal digital business. The paper recommends shifting from broad digital awareness programs to targeted and specific interventions. This movement supports practical e-commerce adoption, strengthen digital payment usage also, improve SME digital measurement systems. Which ultimately reduce regional digital inequalities as well. These measures can enhance SME productivity, promote financial inclusion, and contribute to Sri Lanka’s broader digital economy.

AI.tldr: 本文是一项关于斯里兰卡中小企业数字化转型的政策洞见研究。研究发现尽管互联网用户增长，但多数中小企业仍停留在基础数字活动（如营销和沟通），未能广泛采用电商系统、数字支付和集成化商业技术，从而限制了生产力提升和SDG 8目标的实现。论文基于技术-组织-环境（TOE）框架，识别了技术整合不足、数字能力欠缺、财务约束、信任问题和非正规数字企业信息缺失等障碍，并提出从广泛数字意识项目转向针对性干预措施的政策建议。
AI.research_question: 斯里兰卡中小企业数字化转型面临哪些障碍？以及如何弥合政策层面倡议与企业层面采纳之间的实施差距？
AI.motivation: 斯里兰卡中小企业对GDP和就业贡献巨大，尽管国家拥有完善的法律框架和数字倡议，但政策与企业采纳之间仍存在明显的实施差距，制约了生产力提升和可持续发展目标（SDG 8）的达成。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术-组织-环境（TOE）框架
AI.method: 政策洞见分析（Policy Insight Paper），基于技术、组织、环境三维视角对中小企业数字化转型障碍进行系统审视。
AI.findings: 识别出五大主要障碍：技术整合缺乏、中小企业数字能力不足、财务约束、信任问题、以及对非正规数字企业信息掌握不足。现有数字倡议以广泛的意识提升为主，缺乏针对性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将TOE框架应用于发展中国家中企业数字转型的政策分析场景，揭示了政策层面与微观企业采纳之间实施差距的结构性原因。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出将广泛的数字意识项目转向针对性的具体干预措施，包括：促进实际电商采纳、加强数字支付使用、改善中小企业数字衡量体系，以减少区域数字不平等、提升中小企业生产力并促进金融包容性。

title: The Spillover Effect of Private Firm Disclosure on Public Firms' Loan Pricing
affiliations: Shanghai University of Finance and Economics - School of Accountancy, The University of Hong Kong - Faculty of Business and Economics, Hong Kong Polytechnic University - School of Accounting and Finance and

detail.title: The Spillover Effect of Private Firm Disclosure on Public Firms' Loan Pricing
detail.abstract: We examine whether private firm disclosure affects the price that public firms pay for their bank loans. Using global data on syndicated loans, we find that private firm disclosure significantly reduces public firms' loan spreads. This finding supports a positive information externalities view whereby private firm disclosure helps banks evaluate public borrowers' credit risk within the industry context and reduces information asymmetry between banks and borrowers. Consistent with this mechanism, we find larger reductions in public firms' loan spreads when banks have less information about the borrower or lower expected monitoring intensity, when public-firm borrowers are more informationally opaque, when private firms have greater economic importance in the industry, when private and public firms are more economically similar, or when a larger share of private firms in an industry have audited financial statements. We show that private firm disclosure generates positive externalities for the loan market by reducing information asymmetry.

AI.tldr: 本文利用全球银团贷款数据，研究发现私营企业信息披露显著降低了上市公司银行贷款利差，支持了积极信息外部性观点：私营企业披露帮助银行在行业背景下评估上市公司借款人的信用风险，减少了银行与借款人之间的信息不对称。
AI.research_question: 私营企业信息披露是否会影响上市公司银行贷款的定价（利差）？
AI.motivation: 以往研究多关注上市公司自身的披露对其融资成本的影响，但私营企业披露所产生的外部性对上市公司贷款成本的影响尚未得到充分研究。本文旨在填补这一空白，检验私营企业披露是否通过信息外部性渠道降低上市公司的贷款成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息外部性理论（positive information externalities）；信息不对称理论。
AI.method: 使用全球银团贷款数据，进行实证回归分析，并采用多种调节效应检验（包括银行信息拥有量、监控强度、借款人信息透明度、私营企业行业重要性、公私企业经济相似度、审计比例等）来验证信息外部性机制。
AI.findings: 私营企业信息披露显著降低了上市公司的贷款利差。该效应在以下情况下更强：银行对借款人信息掌握较少或预期监控强度较低时；上市公司借款人信息透明度较低时；私营企业在行业中经济重要性更大时；私营企业与上市公司经济相似度更高时；行业中更大比例的私营企业拥有经审计的财务报表时。
AI.theory_contributions: 为信息披露的积极外部性提供了新证据，表明私营企业披露不仅影响自身融资，还能通过行业信息环境改善，降低同行业上市公司的贷款成本，拓展了信息外部性理论的应用场景。
AI.practical_contributions: 对政策制定者而言，表明鼓励私营企业披露具有超越单个企业的正外部性，能够改善整个行业的信贷市场效率；对银行和借款人而言，揭示了行业披露环境在贷款定价中的重要作用。

title: A Machine Learning Framework for Cross-market Dependency Analysis and Forecasting of Iranian Refinery Stocks
affiliations: K. N. Toosi University of Technology

detail.title: A Machine Learning Framework for Cross-market Dependency Analysis and Forecasting of Iranian Refinery Stocks
detail.abstract: The national economy's structural dependence on oil revenues. This study proposes a machine learning framework for cross-market dependency analysis between global oil market indicators and the stock prices of major Iranian refinery companies listed on the Tehran Stock Exchange. Historical data, including Brent crude oil price, oil trading volume, exchange rate, and temporal variables, were collected and integrated into a unified dataset covering approximately eight years of trading activity. Three machine learning algorithms, including Random Forest Regression, XGBoost Regression, and Polynomial Regression, were evaluated and compared using the R² score and RMSE metrics. Experimental results showed that the Random Forest model achieved the best predictive performance among the evaluated methods, attaining an R² score of 0.9889 and an RMSE of 689.50, while outperforming both XGBoost and Polynomial Regression. The proposed framework was further validated using out-of-sample market observations collected after the training period. The findings indicate that global oil market variables contain substantial predictive information regarding the behaviour of Iranian refinery stocks and can support data-driven investment analysis in energy-dependent financial markets.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一个机器学习框架，用于分析全球石油市场指标与伊朗炼油公司股票价格之间的跨市场依赖关系。通过整合布伦特原油价格、石油交易量、汇率和时间变量，构建了约八年的统一数据集。比较了随机森林回归、XGBoost回归和多项式回归三种算法，其中随机森林表现最佳（R²=0.9889，RMSE=689.50），并通过样本外数据验证了框架的有效性。
AI.research_question: 全球石油市场指标（如布伦特原油价格、交易量、汇率等）与伊朗炼油公司股票价格之间存在怎样的跨市场依赖关系？机器学习方法能否有效捕捉和预测这种关系？
AI.motivation: 伊朗国民经济高度依赖石油收入，石油市场波动对伊朗炼油企业的股票表现具有重要影响。然而，对这种跨市场依赖关系的定量分析仍然不足，需要更先进的方法来支持能源依赖型金融市场中的投资决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨市场依赖分析理论；石油价格传导机制；机器学习预测框架
AI.method: 收集约八年的历史交易数据，整合布伦特原油价格、石油交易量、汇率和时间变量为统一数据集；采用随机森林回归、XGBoost回归和多项式回归三种机器学习算法进行建模；使用R²分数和RMSE指标评估模型性能；利用训练期后的样本外市场观测数据进行验证。
AI.findings: 随机森林模型在三种方法中预测性能最优（R²=0.9889，RMSE=689.50），优于XGBoost和多项式回归；样本外验证证实了框架的有效性；全球石油市场变量对伊朗炼油股票行为包含大量预测信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种基于机器学习框架的跨市场依赖性分析方法，为石油市场与股票市场之间的关系提供了新的定量分析工具，扩展了能源金融领域的方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为能源依赖型金融市场中的数据驱动投资分析提供了实用支持，有助于投资者理解和预测伊朗炼油股票的走势，提升了在石油市场波动背景下的投资决策能力。

title:
Design Accountability: 
Statutes of Repose, the Missing Inspector, and a Knowledge Gate for the People who Design Things

detail.title:
Design Accountability: 
Statutes of Repose, the Missing Inspector, and a Knowledge Gate for the People who Design Things
detail.abstract: Statutes of repose extinguish claims against the designers and builders of things a fixed number of years after completion, regardless of discovery, culpability, or concealment. This Article argues that the doctrine does something worse than deny stale claims: it subsidizes a design strategy. A hazard engineered to fail slowly, hidden where no user can inspect it, will predictably outlast the repose window, and the designer who conceals best is the designer the statute protects most completely. The Article proceeds from a specimen, a Pennsylvania home whose garage slab was built over a concealed void on a single unprotected steel column that corroded for thirty years behind a sealed wall, and generalizes. First, it shows that the finality rationales for repose, lost evidence, faded memory, and fair notice, each collapse when the defendant manufactured the evidentiary silence, and that limitations doctrine already recognizes this through a fraudulent concealment exception that repose alone lacks. Second, it demonstrates that the resulting incentive is not hypothetical by assembling the documented record of design decision concealment across industries: automotive cost benefit suppression, tobacco and asbestos knowledge management, pharmaceutical ghost management, aviation certification concealment, and the built environment itself. Third, it shows that American law already operates downstream harm surveillance in food, motor vehicles, drugs and devices, consumer products, and workplaces, under the closely regulated industry doctrine and mandatory death and injury reporting, and that housing is the conspicuous omission. Drawing on the builder provisions of the Code of Hammurabi as the ancient baseline of unlimited accountability, the Article proposes a knowledge gate as a domain agnostic principle of design accountability: time based liability shields should shelter what could not have been known at the moment of the design decision despite reasonable diligence, and should shelter nothing that was known and concealed. Two transplant reforms follow: a fraudulent concealment carve out in statutes of repose, and early warning reporting for the built environment on the model of 49 U.S.C. § 30166 and Florida's post collapse milestone inspection statute.

AI.tldr: 本文论证时效法（statutes of repose）不仅仅是拒绝陈旧索赔，更是补贴一种"设计策略"——将危害工程化地设计为缓慢失效并隐藏起来，使其在时效窗口结束后才爆发。作者提出"知识门槛"原则：时间责任豁免只应庇护在做出设计决策时经过合理勤勉仍无法知晓的风险，而绝不应庇护已知却被故意隐瞒的风险。基于此提出两项移植改革：时效法中增设欺诈隐瞒例外，以及在建筑环境领域引入早期预警报告制度。
AI.research_question: 时效法在建筑/产品设计领域如何系统性地补贴"隐蔽性缓慢失败设计"策略，以及当前法律框架（欺诈隐瞒例外、行业监管、强制报告）为何未覆盖住房领域？应如何进行制度改革？
AI.motivation: 作者指出时效法（statutes of repose）比普通诉讼时效（statutes of limitations）更极端——它在固定年限后无条件消灭针对设计者和建造者的索赔，不考虑发现时间、过错或隐瞒。这种制度制造了反常激励：设计者通过将危害设计为缓慢失效并深藏于无法检查之处，就能预测性地"熬过"时效窗口。宾夕法尼亚州一处住宅的案例（车库板层建于隐蔽空洞之上，单根未防护钢柱在密封墙后腐蚀30年）作为典型标本，揭示了该制度的深层不公。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 时效法的终局性理论基础重构（证据灭失、记忆衰退、公平通知三逻辑在"被告制造证据沉默"时不成立）；2) 欺诈隐瞒例外在诉讼时效中的既有承认；3) 严格监管行业理论（closely regulated industry doctrine）与强制死亡/伤害报告制度（如49 U.S.C. § 30166）；4) 《汉谟拉比法典》建筑商条款作为无限责任的古代基准。
AI.method: 法学论证与跨行业文献综合：从单一标本案例（宾州住宅事故）出发，通过三个层次展开——（1）概念/逻辑分析（重构终局性论证并揭示其漏洞）；（2）跨行业档案汇编（汽车成本效益抑制、烟草石棉知识管理、制药幽灵管理、航空认证隐瞒、建筑环境）证明激励非假设性；（3）比较法律分析（现有下游危害监测制度在食品、机动车、药品器械、消费品、工作场所的运行，揭示住房的缺位），并提出规范性立法提议。
AI.findings: 1) 时效法的三大终局性理据（证据灭失、记忆衰退、公平通知）在被告主动制造"证据沉默"的情况下全部瓦解，而诉讼时效已有欺诈隐瞒例外，时效法却缺乏对应机制；2) 跨行业档案证明"设计决策故意隐瞒"是普遍存在而非假设性现象；3) 美国法律已经在多个领域建立下游危害监测与强制报告制度，唯独住房被显著遗漏；4) 以汉谟拉比法典为基准，提出"知识门槛"原则与两项改革——时效法欺诈隐瞒例外 + 建筑环境早期预警报告制度。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 重新定义时效法的功能：不仅是否决陈旧索赔的程序工具，更是一种塑造设计激励的实质性制度；2) 提出"知识门槛"（knowledge gate）作为跨领域的通用设计责任原则，为时间责任豁免划出规范边界；3) 将欺诈隐瞒例外从诉讼时效扩展至时效法领域，填补理论空白；4) 将汉谟拉比法典的无限责任原则与现代监管理论结合，构建古代基准到现代制度的历史连续性论证。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提出时效法欺诈隐瞒例外的具体立法改革建议；2) 借鉴49 U.S.C. § 30166，提出针对建筑环境的早期预警强制报告制度；3) 引用佛罗里达州灾后里程碑检测法规作为可移植的立法模板；4) 为立法者、政策制定者和建筑行业提供了将"已知并隐瞒"与"合理勤勉仍不可知"进行区分的可操作标准。

title: The Logic and Consequences of Equalizing Bureaucratic Recruitment: Evidence from the 1073 Examination Reform in Song China
affiliations: Peking University - School of Economics, New York University (NYU) - Wilf Family Department of Politics and Peking University

detail.title: The Logic and Consequences of Equalizing Bureaucratic Recruitment: Evidence from the 1073 Examination Reform in Song China
detail.abstract: We study how equalizing opportunities for bureaucratic recruitment reshapes politics in distinct stages. Initially, it brings more officials from humble backgrounds into the bureaucracy. Their lack of patronage ties, however, limits prospects for career advancement and thus motivates them to seek promotion by displaying exceptional loyalty and zeal in carrying out the ruler's preferred policies, often with downstream effects on governance and social stability. We test this argument using a reform of the civil service examinations in Northern Song China (960-1127), which shifted from literary composition to formulaic interpretation of the Confucian classics, a change that favored candidates from modest backgrounds. The reform increased the presence of nonelite bureaucrats whose hometowns had greater access to printed books. These officials extracted more revenue as prefects, were increasingly assigned to posts implementing the ruler's agenda, pursued the ruler's preferred policies with greater intensity, and faced higher rates of rebellion.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了官僚选拔机会均等化如何在不同阶段重塑政治。以北宋科举改革（从诗赋取士到经义取士）为自然实验，发现该改革增加了寒门出身的官僚比例，这些缺乏庇护关系的官员晋升前景受限，因而通过展现对君主偏好政策的忠诚和热忱来寻求晋升，这导致了更高的税收征收、更积极地执行君主议程，但也伴随着更高的叛乱率。
AI.research_question: 官僚选拔的机会均等化如何在不同阶段重塑政治？具体而言，寒门出身的官员进入官僚体系后，其职业激励如何影响政策执行与社会稳定？
AI.motivation: 传统研究多关注选拔制度的机会均等化本身，但对其后续政治后果——尤其是寒门官员进入官僚体系后的职业激励及其对治理和社会稳定的影响——缺乏系统性理解。本文试图填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于职业激励与政治偏好的理论框架：寒门官员缺乏庇护（patronage）关系，晋升渠道受限，因此会通过展现对统治者偏好政策的极端忠诚和热忱来寻求晋升机会，从而产生过度的政策执行行为。
AI.method: 利用北宋科举改革（从诗赋取士转向儒家经典义理取士）作为自然实验，结合印刷书籍可获得性作为工具变量，采用实证分析方法检验改革对非精英官僚比例、税收征收、任务分配、政策执行强度及叛乱率的影响。
AI.findings: （1）科举改革增加了寒门出身的官僚比例，其家乡印刷书籍可获得性更高；（2）这些官员担任州府长官时征收更多税收；（3）他们更频繁地被分配到实施统治者议程的职位；（4）以更大强度执行统治者偏好的政策；（5）面临更高的叛乱率。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文推进了关于选拔制度与政治结果关系的理论，揭示了机会均等化可能带来的非预期后果——寒门官员的"过度忠诚"行为（over-compliance）可能加剧治理负担并引发社会不稳定，为理解官僚选拔、职业激励与政治稳定之间的动态关系提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为当代公务员选拔改革和官僚体系建设提供历史镜鉴，提示决策者在推进机会均等化的同时需关注官员职业通道的配套设计，避免因晋升激励扭曲导致政策过度执行和社会不稳定。

title: Auction Discounts without Financial Arbitrage: The Pricing of Japan's Indirect Transmission Rights

detail.title: Auction Discounts without Financial Arbitrage: The Pricing of Japan's Indirect Transmission Rights

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses only publicly available electricity market data and involves no human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Japan's indirect transmission rights (ITR) pay holders the day-ahead price spread between adjacent zones. Settlement is capped at the holder's own physical spot transactions, and no secondary market exists. A March 2025 government review found auction clearing prices persistently below realized spreads. Its remedy raises the auction's 0.01 yen/kWh minimum offer price from FY2026. We quantify and decompose the gap using all 2,306 weekly products auctioned between FY2019 and FY2026. Contracted rights returned buyers 0.30 to 0.53 yen/kWh over the price paid, depending on the settlement bound. Outcomes are tail-driven, and the median product roughly broke even. The discount is structural rather than a floor problem alone. Clearing prices respond to observable ex-ante congestion risk with 43-50% of the slope at which spreads realize. The shortfall concentrates in competitively priced products, which carry three times the deficit of floor-priced ones. Supply is released mechanically, and settlement rules foreclose purely financial participation, so no arbitrage capital can close the gap. The discount is an equilibrium feature of a hedger-only auction with thin demand. This supports the review's participation diagnosis but not its price-floor remedy. Early FY2026 data show fewer floor clearings and no improvement against the pre-2025 baseline. The Japanese design offers a rare measurement of locational forward pricing when the marginal bidder is a physical hedger rather than an arbitrageur.

AI.tldr: 本文研究日本间接输电权（ITR）拍卖中，结算价格持续低于实际价差的系统性折价问题。基于2019-2026财年全部2306个周度产品的拍卖数据，量化并分解了折价结构，发现折价是均衡特征而非简单的定价下限问题，并评估了2025年3月政府提出的最低报价价格调整政策的效果。
AI.research_question: 日本间接输电权拍卖中，拍卖清算价格为何持续低于实际实现的价差？这种折价的结构性根源是什么？价格下限调整能否有效修复该问题？
AI.motivation: 2025年3月日本政府审查发现拍卖清算价格持续低于实际价差，并决定从2026财年起提高拍卖0.01日元/kWh的最低报价。作者旨在通过全面数据量化折价规模、分解其结构成因，并评估政策补救措施的合理性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 输电权拍卖定价理论、金融输电权与实物输电权比较、均衡定价中的对冲者-套利者结构分析。
AI.method: 使用2019-2026财年全部2,306个周度拍卖产品的完整数据集，对合同权利购买方回报进行量化分析（0.30-0.53日元/kWh），通过中位数与均值对比识别尾部驱动特征，并通过回归分析清算价格对预期拥堵风险的响应弹性（43-50%）。
AI.findings: （1）签约权利为买方带来0.30-0.53日元/kWh的超额回报，但结果高度由尾部驱动，中位数产品基本盈亏平衡；（2）折价是结构性现象而非单纯的价格下限问题；（3）清算价格对可观察的拥堵风险的响应斜率仅为实际价差实现斜率的43-50%；（4）赤字集中在竞争性定价产品上，其赤字是下限定价产品的三倍；（5）供给机械性释放、结算规则排除纯金融参与，导致无套利资本能消除价差；（6）早期2026财年数据显示下限清算减少但对2025年前基线无改善。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了当边际投标者为实物对冲者而非套利者时的区位前瞻定价的罕见实证测量，揭示了仅有对冲者参与的拍卖市场中折价作为均衡特征的理论含义。
AI.practical_contributions: 对日本政府的政策提出实证评估——支持其参与度诊断但质疑其价格下限修复方案的有效性，为输电权市场设计和监管改革提供数据驱动依据。

detail.abstract: The gig economy is widely accepted and booming in the era of Artificial Intelligence (AI) across the globe. In the gig economy, the aggregators and laborers are beneficiaries. Laborers in this economy are called gig workers. Gig workers do not fall under the traditional employee list. There is no universally accepted definition for gig laborers. Except for a few States in India, there are no legal protections for their social lives. In this context, the present study aims to conduct a policy analysis of gig laborers to understand the socio-legal aspects of this phenomenon. Further, to analyze how algorithmic management in the gig economy creates a gap between existing legal frameworks and the effective social protection of gig workers. To examine the above objectives, the present study used secondary data to analyze policies regarding gig laborers. Additionally, to analyse the gap between the legal framework and the social protection of gig laborers through Algorithmic Management, the study collected primary data. The total sample size is 260. Among these, 99 are from the rider's app, and the rest of them are from delivery apps. The results show a wider gap between the existing legal framework and the social protection it effectively provides. To conclude, the Government should adopt a policy imperative to establish a comprehensive legal framework to protect them and ensure legal protection for social life.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了人工智能时代零工经济中零工劳动者的社会法律保护问题，通过政策分析和实证调研（样本量260），揭示了现有法律框架与零工劳动者实际社会保护之间存在的巨大鸿沟，并提出政府应建立全面法律框架的政策建议。
AI.research_question: 1. 零工劳动者在社会法律层面面临哪些问题？2. 算法管理如何在零工经济中造成现有法律框架与零工劳动者有效社会保护之间的差距？
AI.motivation: 零工经济在AI时代蓬勃发展，但零工劳动者不被视为传统雇员，缺乏普遍接受的定义，除印度少数邦外几乎没有社会生活的法律保护，这一法律真空亟需关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政策分析框架、算法管理理论、社会保护理论
AI.method: 混合方法：使用二手数据进行政策分析；通过一手数据收集（问卷/调研），样本量为260人，其中99人来自骑手应用，其余来自配送应用，用于分析法律框架与社会保护之间的差距。
AI.findings: 现有法律框架与零工劳动者实际获得的社会保护之间存在着显著的、广泛的差距。法律条文虽在，但未能有效覆盖零工劳动者的社会保护需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了算法管理作为新兴因素如何加剧法律框架滞后于零工经济实践的矛盾，为算法管理与社会法律保护的交叉研究提供了实证依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府提供了明确政策建议：应建立全面的法律框架以确保零工劳动者社会生活的法律保护；为印度及其他国家的零工经济政策制定提供参考。

title: Electric Vehicle Transition and Macroeconomic Dynamics in Indonesia: Evidence from a Recursive Dynamic Computable General Equilibrium Model
affiliations: Padjadjaran University - Faculty of Economics and Business

detail.title: Electric Vehicle Transition and Macroeconomic Dynamics in Indonesia: Evidence from a Recursive Dynamic Computable General Equilibrium Model

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Not Available
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not Available
declarations.funderStatement: Not Available

detail.abstract: This paper examines the economy-wide impacts of Indonesia's electric vehicle (EV) transition using a recursive dynamic computable general equilibrium (CGE) model calibrated to a 185-sector Indonesian social accounting matrix. A nested constant-elasticity-of-substitution (CES) household transport choice module-embedding endogenous ICEV-EV substitution (σ = 3.0) with technology learning (1.5% per annum battery cost reduction) and a phased EV subsidy policyis solved recursively over the horizon 2024-2050. Simulation results indicate that EV market share reaches 100% by 2044 under the baseline scenario, driving a 68% reduction in transport carbon emissions relative to 2024 levels (222,048 kt to 70,824 kt CO 2 eq) while real GDP expands 2.4-fold. An endogenous revenuerecycled carbon price-peaking at 6.2 × 10-4 model units in 2037 before declining as electrification matures-finances EV subsidies without crowding out household income. The model demonstrates that EV transition and sustained economic growth can be jointly achieved in the Indonesian context, providing empirical support for Indonesia's National EV Roadmap targets.

AI.tldr: 本文使用递归动态可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型，基于185部门印度尼西亚社会核算矩阵，评估印尼电动汽车（EV）转型的宏观经济影响。模型嵌入嵌套CES家庭交通选择模块（ICEV-EV替代弹性σ=3.0）、技术学习（电池成本年降1.5%）和分阶段EV补贴政策，模拟2024-2050年。结果显示基线情景下EV市场份额2044年达100%，交通碳排放较2024年减少68%（从222,048千吨降至70,824千吨CO2当量），实际GDP增长2.4倍。内生碳价（2037年峰值6.2×10⁻⁴模型单位）通过收入循环为EV补贴融资，不挤出家庭收入。研究表明EV转型与持续经济增长可在印尼同时实现，为印尼国家EV路线图目标提供实证支持。
AI.research_question: 印尼电动汽车转型对整体经济的影响是什么？EV转型能否与持续经济增长同时实现？
AI.motivation: 印尼作为发展中经济体，面临交通脱碳与经济增长的双重目标挑战。已有研究缺乏对印尼EV转型宏观经济的系统评估，需要为印尼国家EV路线图目标提供实证支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可计算一般均衡（CGE）理论；嵌套常替代弹性（CES）效用函数；内生技术学习曲线；端性碳价收入循环机制。
AI.method: 构建递归动态CGE模型，基于185部门印尼社会核算矩阵校淮；嵌套CES家庭交通选择模块（σ=3.0）；嵌入电池技术学习（年降1.5%）与分阶段EV补贴政策；在2024-2050年时间跨度内递归求解。
AI.findings: （1）基线情景下EV市场份额2044年达到100%；（2）交通碳排放较2024年减少68%（222,048→70,824 kt CO2 eq）；（3）实际GDP扩张2.4倍；（4）内生碳价2037年达峰值6.2×10⁻⁴模型单位后随电动化成熟而下降；（5）碳价收入循环可为EV补贴融资而不挤出家庭收入。
AI.theory_contributions: 将EV转型嵌入一般均衡框架，整合内生技术学习与碳价收入循环机制，拓展了CGE模型在交通能源转型领域的应用；通过递归动态设定捕捉了长期转型路径的非线性特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印尼国家EV路线图目标提供实证支撑，证明EV转型与经济增长可协同实现；为政策制定者提供碳价与补贴政策协同设计的量化依据；为其他发展中经济体推进电动化转型提供可参考的模型框架与政策启示。

title: Wealth Transfer in Practice: Client Retention Across Generations at Boutique Registered Investment Advisers

detail.title: Wealth Transfer in Practice: Client Retention Across Generations at Boutique Registered Investment Advisers
detail.abstract: The United States is in the middle of what researchers are calling the largest intergenerational wealth transfer in history, with an estimated $84 trillion expected to change hands over the next two decades. This paper examines what that actually looks like from the inside of boutique wealth management firms. From October 2025 to February 2026, I worked as a wealth management intern, where I had a front-row seat to the operational, relational, and educational dimensions of serving clients whose estates will eventually pass to the next generation. Since February 2026, I have continued in the wealth management space at another registered investment advisory firm where the question of multigenerational wealth retention sits even closer to the center of day-to-day operations. Through a combination of hands-on internship experience across both firms and an extensive review of academic and industry literature, this paper explores why so much inherited wealth disappears within a generation, what the regulatory environment looks like for the RIAs navigating this moment, and what boutique advisory firms can realistically do to serve families across generational lines rather than just individual clients. The paper concludes with a set of concrete recommendations grounded in both the research and in direct practitioner observation. Together, these two internship experiences have given me a fuller picture of how the wealth transfer conversation actually unfolds inside small advisory firms and why the firms that treat it as a relationship challenge rather than a financial planning problem are the ones most likely to survive it.

AI.tldr: 本文基于作者在两家精品财富管理公司的实习经历（2025年10月至2026年2月及2026年2月之后），结合学术与行业文献，探讨美国历史上最大规模的代际财富转移（预计8.4万亿美元）背景下，精品财富管理公司如何应对客户财富跨代留存的问题。文章分析了继承财富流失的原因、RIA（注册投资顾问）的监管环境，并提出面向代际服务的具体建议，强调将财富转移视为关系挑战而非单纯财务规划问题的重要性。
AI.research_question: 在8.4万亿美元代际财富转移背景下，精品财富管理公司如何应对客户财富跨代留存？为什么大量继承财富在一代之内消失？RIA监管环境如何影响这一过程？
AI.motivation: 美国正处于历史上最大规模的代际财富转移期（预计8.4万亿美元），但大量继承财富在一代之内流失。作者通过亲身实习经历观察精品财富管理公司内部运作，试图从实践层面理解财富跨代留存失败的原因及可行的应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代际财富转移理论；财富传承与家族关系管理理论；RIA监管框架分析
AI.method: 参与式观察（两段实习经历）+ 学术与行业文献综述 + 实践者直接观察与归纳分析
AI.findings: 精品财富管理公司中，代际财富转移本质上是一个关系挑战而非单纯的财务规划问题；将财富传承视为关系管理的公司更可能成功留存跨代财富；RIA监管环境对代际服务有重要影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将代际财富转移重新概念化为关系管理问题而非财务规划问题，为财富管理领域的代际服务研究提供了基于内部实践视角的质性观察与理论洞察。
AI.practical_contributions: 为精品财富管理公司提供了基于实践观察与文献研究的可操作建议，包括如何服务跨代家庭客户、如何在RIA监管框架下应对代际财富转移挑战，以及如何将关系导向策略落地。

title: Alpha is All you Need: Moral Rotation and the Pricing of Virtue in Asset Markets
affiliations: University of Oxford

detail.title: Alpha is All you Need: Moral Rotation and the Pricing of Virtue in Asset Markets
detail.abstract: Capital allocation follows expected alpha. Moral labels follow capital. I document the decade's two reversals of sustainable-investment exclusions, defence after 2022 and energy after 2021. The energy rotation began a year before the invasion, which rules out changed moral beliefs, and thermal coal, with no engagement story, confirms it. Separating deliberate trading from price drift, I find sustainability-labelled funds traded the excluded sectors indistinguishably from conventional funds once the alpha appeared, within a pre-specified equivalence bound. The nuclear label alone moved almost no capital. The 285 percent rally moved a quarter of labelled funds in. Labels rotated. Alpha did not.

AI.tldr: 本文记录了可持续投资领域十年间两次排除政策的逆转——2022年后的国防和2021年后的能源。能源轮动在俄乌战争前一年就已开始，排除了道德观念改变的解释；热煤（无参与故事可讲）进一步证实这一点。通过区分刻意交易与价格漂移，作者发现一旦alpha出现，可持续标签基金与普通基金在交易被排除行业方面无法区分（在预先设定的等价界限内）。核能标签几乎未带动任何资金流动，285%的涨幅仅推动四分之一标签基金进入。标签发生轮动，但alpha没有。
AI.research_question: 可持续投资基金的资本配置是真正遵循道德标签，还是在alpha出现后标签会跟随资本轮动？具体而言，可持续投资排除政策在十年间的两次逆转（国防和能源）背后的驱动力是什么？
AI.motivation: 可持续投资领域存在关于资本配置动机的根本争论——究竟是道德信念驱动资金流动，还是资金追逐alpha时标签会相应调整。两次逆转提供了自然实验来区分这两种解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续投资中的标签与资本配置关系理论，道德信念与alpha追逐的竞争性假设，以及刻意交易与价格漂移的区分框架。
AI.method: 利用十年间两次可持续投资排除逆转（2021年能源、2022年国防）作为自然实验；比较能源轮动时间点与战争爆发时间点；以热煤作为无参与机制的对照组；采用预设等价界限方法区分刻意交易与价格漂移；分析核能标签的资金流向。
AI.findings: (1)能源轮动在俄乌战争前一年已开始，排除道德信念变化解释；(2)热煤无参与故事却同样轮动，进一步确认alpha驱动；(3)一旦alpha出现，可持续标签基金与普通基金的交易行为在等价界限内无法区分；(4)核能标签几乎未移动资本，尽管285%涨幅仅带动四分之一标签基金进入。
AI.theory_contributions: 表明可持续投资标签更多是跟随资本流动的"事后合理化"，而非驱动资本配置的"事前约束"。挑战了可持续投资基金真正坚持道德排除假设的观点，揭示alpha最大化的核心逻辑在标签基金中同样成立。
AI.practical_contributions: 对可持续投资基金的真实动机提供实证证据，帮助投资者评估ESG基金标签的可信度；提示监管者和政策制定者关注可持续投资标签的制度设计，防止"洗标签"行为。

publicationDetails.detailsText: This paper is based on Chapter 1 of the author’s PhD thesis, Essays on laws, norms, and innovation (University of St Andrews, 2026).

detail.abstract: We study a dynamic information design problem à la Albano and Lizzeri (2001) in which a regulator can disclose unobserved quality information as the norms of a population evolve. Under moral hazard, the regulator sets a pass-fail standard ex-ante. Firms choose whether to produce and sell an asset to a population of consumers. Over time, consumers' purchase decision depends on the signal, others' buying behaviour, and norm evolution. In this paper, we use evolutionary game theory to describe the tension between quality certification and norm persistence, showing that targeted standards can eliminate bad norms and raise consumer welfare.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在规范（社会规范）演化背景下，监管者如何通过信息披露设计（通过/不通过标准）来消除不良社会规范并提高消费者福利的问题。
AI.research_question: 在道德风险条件下，监管者应如何设定事前的通过/不通过标准，以在规范演化中消除不良规范并提升消费者福利？
AI.motivation: 现有文献（如Albano和Lizzeri 2001）关注静态信息设计，但现实中消费者的购买行为受社会规范动态演化的影响，质量认证与规范持续性之间存在张力，需要理解这一动态交互过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 演化博弈论；动态信息设计；道德风险
AI.method: 理论建模：构建动态信息设计模型，采用演化博弈理论刻画消费者规范的演化过程，分析监管者设定的事前通过/不通过标准对规范演化和消费者福利的影响。
AI.findings: 有针对性的（targeted）质量标准可以消除不良社会规范，并提高消费者福利；质量认证与规范持久性之间存在张力，合理的标准设计能够化解这一张力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将演化博弈论引入动态信息设计框架，首次从理论层面揭示了质量认证与社会规范演化之间的互动机制，拓展了Albano和Lizzeri（2001）的静态信息设计模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者设计质量标准提供了指导：通过设定有针对性的标准，可以有效引导社会规范向好的方向演化，提升市场中的消费者福利。

title: Topic: Parameter Stability and Time-Varying Production Functions : A Case Study of Coefficient Changes through the Cobb-Douglass Production Function on the Economy of Papua New Guinea

detail.title: Topic: Parameter Stability and Time-Varying Production Functions : A Case Study of Coefficient Changes through the Cobb-Douglass Production Function on the Economy of Papua New Guinea

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This study was a desk-top study and was done independently and no field work done.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The author alone did the study.
declarations.funderStatement: There was no funding for this study.

detail.abstract: This case study has used four Cobb-Douglass production models on the data of the Papua New Guinean economy to test whether elasticity coefficients of the labor and capital variables changed accordingly due to changes in the data points on the time series annual data. We have confirmed in all the four models that the coefficients do change even if one single data point was changed during regressions. However, to confirm that these changes were real and significant three tests were conducted to verify the regression results. The Chow test on the general data and model structure, Wald dummy variable test on the interaction of the factors of production and the Z-test on the dominant coefficient factor. Generally the test results confirmed that there was a structural change in the economy of Papua New Guinea therefore it is not wise to use the same coefficients of the baseline model 1 to forecast future outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用四个Cobb-Douglass生产模型对巴布亚新几内亚经济数据进行案例分析，验证了劳动力和资本变量的弹性系数会随着时间序列数据点变化而改变。通过Chow检验、Wald虚拟变量检验和Z检验证实了经济体存在结构性变化，因此不建议使用基线模型的系数进行未来预测。
AI.research_question: 巴布亚新几内亚经济中劳动力和资本的弹性系数是否会随着时间序列数据点的变化而发生显著改变？
AI.motivation: 检验在时间序列数据中，即使改变单个数据点，Cobb-Douglass生产函数的弹性系数是否保持稳定，以及该经济是否存在结构性变化从而影响预测的准确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: Cobb-Douglass生产函数模型、结构性变化理论
AI.method: 采用四个Cobb-Douglass生产模型进行回归分析，并运用Chow检验、Wald虚拟变量检验和Z检验验证回归结果的显著性和结构性变化。
AI.findings: 四个模型均证实即使只改变一个数据点，弹性系数也会发生变化。三种检验结果证实巴布亚新几内亚经济存在结构性变化，使用基线模型1的系数进行未来预测是不明智的。
AI.theory_contributions: 为Cobb-Douglass生产函数在发展中国家小经济体中的适用性提供了实证证据，揭示了弹性系数对数据点的敏感性及结构性变化对模型预测的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴布亚新几内亚等发展中经济体的经济预测和政策制定提供警示，强调需要定期更新模型参数并关注经济结构性变化。

title: Midterms and the Iran War: Political Time, Defining Power, and the Post-Westphalian Transition
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Midterms and the Iran War: Political Time, Defining Power, and the Post-Westphalian Transition

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This work is a conceptual and theoretical study and does not involve human participants, personal data, or animal subjects. Therefore, ethical approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper argues that the trajectory of the U.S.–Iran war is constrained less by battlefield capability than by political time: elections, media-defined frames, and the durability of public consent. The central variable is defining power—the ability to fix the meaning of the war in a fragmented information environment. The paper develops three linked claims. First, a structural conflict between the administration and established media institutions weakens coordinated agenda-setting in wartime. Second, the reversal of diplomatic normalisation after 7 October 2023 illustrates how quickly regional predictability can be undone when proxy architectures reintroduce high-intensity conflict. Third, the U.S. midterm cycle exerts a gravitational pull towards short-term stabilisation over strategic completion, making definitional power and public support decisive constraints on strategic resolve. In developing this claim, the paper also argues that procedural framing, curated voices, and conclusion-first framing can narrow interpretive openness and pre-empt longer-horizon arguments about order, while linked patterns of technology transfer, capital flow, and uneven security responsibility complicate contemporary claims to regional and wider leadership. Throughout, the paper separates factual claims from scenario-level inference and treats projections with caution.

AI.tldr: 本文认为美伊战争的轨迹更多受制于"政治时间"（选举周期、媒体框架与公众同意持续性），而非战场能力。核心变量是"定义权力"——在碎片化信息环境中为战争赋予意义的能力。文章提出三个相互关联的主张：行政当局与主流媒体机构之间的结构性冲突削弱战时议程设置的协调性；2023年10月7日后外交正常化的逆转表明代理架构重新引入高强度冲突时地区可预测性迅速瓦解；美国中期选举周期产生向短期稳定而非战略完成倾斜的引力，使定义权与公众支持成为战略决心的决定性约束。
AI.research_question: 美伊战争轨迹受何种因素约束？政治时间（选举周期、媒体框架、公众同意）如何在碎片化信息环境中塑造战争定义与战略决心？
AI.motivation: 传统军事分析过度聚焦战场能力对比，忽视了在碎片化媒体环境中政治时间因素对战争轨迹的关键约束作用，需要重新审视定义权在战时政治中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治时间理论、议程设置理论、定义权力理论、公众同意/合法性理论、代理冲突架构理论
AI.method: 概念分析与理论推演，结合美伊关系历史案例（2003年伊拉克战争、2023年10月7日后形势）进行论证，区分事实性主张与情景级推断。
AI.findings: （1）行政当局与媒体制度间的结构性冲突削弱了战时协调议程设置的能力；（2）外交正常化在2023年10月7日后迅速逆转，区域可预测性被代理架构的高强度冲突所瓦解；（3）美国中期选举周期推动政策偏向短期稳定而非战略完成；（4）程序性框架、策展声音与结论先行框架限制了阐释开放性，阻碍了关于秩序的长视野论证；（5）技术转移、资本流动与不均等安全责任模式使区域及更广泛的领导权主张复杂化。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"定义权力"确立为理解战时政治的核心变量，整合政治时间与媒体框架分析，拓展了战争政治学中关于公众同意与战略决心的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解美伊关系及更广泛的区域冲突提供"政治时间"维度的分析工具，提示决策需考量选举周期、媒体环境与公众支持的交互作用。

title: Aggregate Demand Shocks and the Great Recession
affiliations: The University of Austin

detail.title: Aggregate Demand Shocks and the Great Recession
detail.abstract: The deepest quarters of the Great Recession exhibited below-expected inflation and real GDP growth, indicating they were driven by shocks to aggregate demand (AD). To gauge the severity of these shocks, I calculate unexpected inflation and GDP growth as differences from the quarterly forecasts by the Federal Reserve Board staff from 1982 through 2019. Using regression analysis, I estimate the effects of ADdriven inflation shocks on real GDP growth. I find that AD shocks account for approximately 75% of the cumulative GDP shortfall in Great Recession. I discuss the implications of these results for improving monetary policy.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1982-2019年美联储理事会工作人员的季度预测数据，计算未预期的通胀和GDP增长，通过回归分析估计总需求驱动的通胀冲击对实际GDP增长的影响，发现总需求冲击约解释了大衰退期间累计GDP缺口的75%，并讨论了其对改进货币政策的启示。
AI.research_question: 大衰退期间的总需求冲击对实际GDP增长的影响有多大？
AI.motivation: 大衰退最严重的几个季度出现了低于预期的通胀和实际GDP增长，表明这些衰退是由总需求冲击驱动的。量化总需求冲击的严重程度有助于评估衰退根源和改进货币政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 总需求-总供给（AD-AS）框架，基于通胀与GDP增长同时低于预期来识别总需求冲击。
AI.method: 使用1982-2019年美联储理事会工作人员的季度预测数据，计算实际值与预测值的差异作为未预期通胀和GDP增长，通过回归分析估计总需求驱动的通胀冲击对实际GDP增长的影响。
AI.findings: 总需求冲击约占大衰退期间累计GDP缺口的75%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一种利用央行内部预测数据识别和量化总需求冲击的方法，将未预期通胀作为总需求冲击的代理指标，丰富了宏观经济学中经济衰退成因的实证研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 量化了总需求冲击在大衰退中的主导作用，为货币政策制定者提供了改进政策的设计依据，强调了在评估衰退严重程度时考虑总需求因素的重要性。

title: Skill Measurement in Thermal Soaring: Exploitation, Selection, and a Research Agenda for Instructional Assistance that Withdraws
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Skill Measurement in Thermal Soaring: Exploitation, Selection, and a Research Agenda for Instructional Assistance that Withdraws
detail.abstract:
Autonomous systems can now find and exploit thermal updrafts without human input. Separately, guidance indexed to a learner's estimated latent skill has been shown to outperform both no guidance and guidance indexed to performance error. Neither literature has been applied to teaching a human pilot to exploit rising air, and no validated measure of soaring skill exists. 

This paper argues that thermal soaring is an unusually informative domain for skill-state-aware assistance, because it has no reference trajectory: the correct action depends on an invisible and shifting airflow field, so assistance cannot be defined as error correction and must instead be indexed to an estimate of how well the learner is extracting information from the air. 

We propose that soaring skill consists of two measurable families. Exploitation concerns the quality of a pilot's response to the mechanosensory cues that a successful autonomous controller was shown to require. Selection concerns which available lift a pilot chooses to use. Selection has been treated as unmeasurable from an individual pilot's flight log because a thermal the pilot declines leaves no trace in that record. We show how pooling logs across pilots can overcome this limitation, and we report a preliminary demonstration: one day of publicly available data yielded 20,171 segmented thermal climbs from 933 flights across latitudes from 37 degrees south to 61 degrees north. 

We describe an assistance architecture indexed to a latent skill estimate derived from these measures, set out a three-study programme with explicit falsification conditions, and state the specific limits of each data source.

AI.tldr: 本文提出滑翔热上升是一种特别适合技能状态感知辅助的领域，因为它没有参考轨迹。作者将滑翔技能分为两个可测量的家族——开发利用（Exploitation）和选择（Selection），并展示了如何通过跨飞行员汇总飞行日志来克服选择不可测量的限制，还描述了一种基于潜在技能估计的辅助架构。
AI.research_question: 如何定义和测量人类飞行员的滑翔热上升技能，并据此设计技能状态感知的辅助系统？
AI.motivation: 自主系统已能无人类输入地利用热上升气流，且技能状态感知的指导已被证明优于无指导或基于错误的指导，但这两个文献分支都未应用于教学人类飞行员利用上升气流，且缺乏经过验证的滑翔技能测量方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技能状态感知辅助理论（latent skill estimation）、滑翔技能双家族框架（Exploitation与Selection）：利用指飞行员对机械感觉线索的反应质量，选择指飞行员选择使用何种可用上升气流。
AI.method: 提出了滑翔技能的两种可测量家族框架；通过跨飞行员汇总飞行日志来弥补单飞行员日志中无法观测被拒绝热上升的局限；利用公开数据（933次飞行，20171个热上升爬升段，覆盖南纬37度至北纬61度）进行初步演示；设计了三阶段研究计划并给出明确的证伪条件。
AI.findings: 一天的公开数据产生了20171个分割的热上升爬升段，来自933次飞行，纬度范围从南纬37度到北纬61度，初步证明了跨飞行员日志汇总是可行的方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了滑翔技能的双家族测量框架（Exploitation与Selection），论证了热滑翔是无参考轨迹领域中技能感知辅助的典型案例，并展示了如何通过日志池化解决个体不可观测性难题。
AI.practical_contributions: 描述了基于潜在技能估计的辅助架构，设计了三阶段研究计划（含明确证伪条件），为开发面向人类飞行员的热滑翔技能培训辅助系统提供了可操作的路径。

title: AI Is Coming for the Economic Consulting Industry
affiliations: and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: AI Is Coming for the Economic Consulting Industry

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required because this study did not involve human participants, patient data, or identifiable personal information.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence will change the market for economic consultants, likely reducing overall demand and shifting workers tocurrent clients’ in-house units. However, both consulting firms and clients are still studying how to deploy AI, and there may yetbe new opportunities for consultants as AI changes the broader economy.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨人工智能将如何改变经济咨询市场，指出AI可能会减少总体咨询需求，并将工作人员转移到现有客户的内部部门。同时，咨询公司和客户仍在探索如何部署AI，且随着AI改变更广泛的经济格局，咨询顾问可能会出现新的机会。
AI.research_question: 人工智能将如何改变经济咨询市场？具体而言，AI对经济咨询顾问的总体需求、就业结构以及客户关系将产生何种影响？
AI.motivation: 随着人工智能技术的快速发展和广泛应用，经济咨询行业正处于转型的临界点。理解AI对咨询市场的影响，对咨询公司、咨询从业者以及客户企业都具有重要的战略意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文可能基于技术变革与劳动力市场理论、产业结构演进理论以及咨询服务供需理论来构建分析框架。
AI.method: 该摘要未详细说明具体研究方法，可能基于行业分析、案例研究或经济建模等方法。
AI.findings: （1）AI可能降低经济咨询的总体需求；（2）咨询工作将从外部咨询公司转移到客户的内部部门；（3）咨询公司和客户仍处于AI部署的探索阶段；（4）随着AI改变整体经济格局，咨询顾问可能面临新的机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文有助于理解人工智能对专业服务行业劳动力市场结构的理论影响，拓展了技术替代与职业转型的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济咨询公司提供了战略调整建议，帮助其应对AI带来的需求变化；为咨询从业者提供了职业规划方向；为客户企业优化内部团队建设与AI部署提供参考。

title: Revisiting the Rules-versus-Discretion Debate: Forecasting Evidence from the Bank of England, 1870-1913
affiliations: Independent Researcher, USA.

detail.title: Revisiting the Rules-versus-Discretion Debate: Forecasting Evidence from the Bank of England, 1870-1913
detail.abstract: Under the classical gold standard, historians have long debated what guided the Bank of England's adjustments to Bank Rate: whether policy followed a mechanical goldstandard rule or discretion when City or exchange conditions required it, and whether domestic money-market stability or external convertibility carried greater weight. This paper revisits those questions with a London-specific monthly panel, 1870-1913, jointly testing ten domestic and external indicators the Court watched when setting the published minimum rate. The findings fit neither a single frozen channel nor unstructured ad hoc policy. Instead, the Bank appears to have drawn repeatedly on a multivariate information settrade settlement, gold movements, City asset prices, billmarket conditions, and episodic convertibility pressurewith state-dependent weights across subperiods. In the confirmatory specification, exports, gold flow, and industrial share prices carry the clearest joint forecasting content for changes in Bank Rate. Gold flow forecasts rate changes even when reserve stock does not, separating bullion settlement from balance-sheet position. Bill-market and convertibility pressures also carry incremental forecasting content in the multivariate specification, though their prominence depends on how domestic and external indicators are modeled together. The overall pattern is most consistent with systematic discretion under the classical gold standard.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1870-1913年伦敦月度面板数据，重新审视经典金本位制下英格兰银行调整银行利率（Bank Rate）的依据，发现政策既非遵循单一机械的金本位规则，也非无结构的临时决策，而是基于多变量信息集（贸易结算、黄金流动、城市资产价格、票据市场状况和偶发的可兑换性压力）进行系统性自由裁量，其中出口、黄金流动和工业股票价格对利率变动具有最清晰的联合预测能力。
AI.research_question: 在经典金本位制下，英格兰银行调整银行利率的依据是什么？政策是遵循机械的金本位规则还是基于城市或汇兑条件的自由裁量？国内货币市场稳定与外部可兑换性哪个权重更大？
AI.motivation: 历史学界长期争论英格兰银行在金本位制下的利率政策制定逻辑：是机械遵循金本位规则还是基于具体情况的自由裁量，以及国内货币市场稳定与外部可兑换性孰轻孰重的问题悬而未决。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经典金本位理论、金本位规则（规则vs自由裁量）理论、中央银行货币政策决策理论。
AI.method: 采用1870-1913年伦敦特定月度面板数据，对英格兰银行理事会设定公布最低利率时关注的十个国内外指标进行联合检验，使用多元预测（confirmatory specification）模型分析各指标的联合预测内容。
AI.findings: 1. 政策既不遵循单一固定渠道也不属于无结构临时决策；2. 英格兰银行反复依赖多变量信息集（贸易结算、黄金流动、城市资产价格、票据市场状况和偶发可兑换性压力），且各子时期权重随状态变化；3. 出口、黄金流动和工业股票价格对利率变化具有最清晰的联合预测能力；4. 黄金流动即使储备存量不变也能预测利率变化，将黄金融资结算与资产负债表头寸区分开来；5. 票据市场和可兑换性压力在多元规范中也具有增量预测内容，但其显著性取决于国内外指标如何共同建模；6. 整体模式最符合经典金本位下的系统性自由裁量。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 否定了单一机械金本位规则假设，也否定了完全临时性政策观点；2. 揭示了经典金本位下中央银行运用多变量信息集进行系统性自由裁量的政策逻辑；3. 区分了黄金流动（结算）与储备存量（资产负债表头寸）对利率决策的独立影响；4. 为理解规则与自由裁量之争提供了新的经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为现代中央银行政策制定提供了历史参照，说明基于多指标信息集进行系统性决策的可行性；2. 为理解金本位时期货币政策的实际操作提供了实证基础；3. 对当代国际金融体系中汇率管理与货币政策协调具有启示意义。

title: Objective on the Outside, Presumptive on The Inside: Qualifying The Habitual Tax Debtor between Patrimonial Fictions, Burden-of-Proof Reversal, and The Requirement of Clear and Convincing Evidence (Brazilian Complementary Law No. 225/2026)
affiliations: University of Coimbra Institute for Legal Research

detail.title: Objective on the Outside, Presumptive on The Inside: Qualifying The Habitual Tax Debtor between Patrimonial Fictions, Burden-of-Proof Reversal, and The Requirement of Clear and Convincing Evidence (Brazilian Complementary Law No. 225/2026)
detail.abstract:
Brazil's federal regime for the habitual tax debtor (devedor contumaz), created by
Complementary Law No. 225/2026 and implemented by Joint Ordinance RFB/PGFN/MF No. 6/2026,
presents itself as a set of objective, cumulative criteria. This article addresses a question logically prior to
the prevailing debate over criteria and consequences: how each element of habitual default is proven,
who bears the burden of proving it, and under what degree of conviction the authority decides. The
analysis shows that all three statutory elements rest on normatively constructed inputs: substantiality
takes total assets as its denominator — a magnitude that measures balance-sheet size rather than
solvency, and one that missing bookkeeping reduces to zero through a regulatory fiction lacking
statutory basis; on a literal reading, credits whose enforceability is suspended under article 151, III, of
the National Tax Code may be counted as irregular for recurrence purposes; and lack of justification,
framed as an absence, shifts onto the taxpayer the proof of negative facts. The qualification procedure
stacks an automatic reversal of the burden of proof and deemed confession by default within proceedings
of a punitive nature, while the regime itself demands a final administrative or judicial decision merely to
remove an ancillary procedural effect — an asymmetry that reveals the appropriate measure. The article
concludes that qualification requires clear and convincing evidence of each element, forbidding the
combination of fiction, reversal and default as a substitute for evidentiary instruction, and proposes four
operational parameters: reading 'irregular status' consistently with the Tax Code; construing known
assets in light of ability to pay; replacing the zero-asset fiction with duly reasoned indirect assessment
modeled on the Tax Code's arbitramento; and adopting the intermediate standard of proof.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨巴西《补充法第225/2026号》建立的"惯常税务债务人"制度中一个先于标准与后果争论的逻辑前提问题：惯常违约各构成要素如何证明、由谁承担举证责任、以及行政机关应在何种证明标准下作出决定。分析表明三个法定要素均建立在规范性建构的输入之上，文章主张资格认定需要清晰且令人信服的证据，禁止用推定、举证责任倒置和默认承认的组合替代证据调查，并提出四项操作性参数。
AI.research_question: 在巴西惯常税务债务人（devedor contumaz）制度中，各构成要素（重大性、不规则状态、缺乏正当理由）如何被证明？谁承担举证责任？行政机关应在何种确信程度下作出资格认定决定？
AI.motivation: 现有讨论集中于惯常税务债务人制度的认定标准和法律后果，但忽视了更根本的证明问题——各要素的证据性质、举证责任分配和证明标准尚未得到系统检视，而这些前提性问题直接影响制度的正当性和适用精度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 证据法理论（举证责任分配、证明标准层次）、税收程序法理论（纳税能力原则、税务评估制度）、行政法中的证明与推定理论。
AI.method: 规范分析/法律解释方法，通过对巴西《国家税法典》第151条III款、有关"重大性"和"缺乏正当理由"的法条文义解释，结合监管推定（零资产虚构）、举证责任倒置和默认承认制度的批判性分析。
AI.findings: （1）"重大性"以总资产为分母，衡量的是资产负债表的规模而非偿付能力，且缺失簿记通过缺乏法定依据的监管虚构使资产归零；（2）按文义解释，根据《国家税法典》第151条III款中止可执行性的债权可能被计为不规则；（3）"缺乏正当理由"作为否定性事实的框架，将举证负担转移给了纳税人；（4）资格认定程序叠加了自动举证责任倒置和缺席默认承认，且该制度仅要求最终行政或司法决定来移除辅助性程序效果——这种不对称性揭示了适当的衡量标准。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地从证据法视角审视惯常税务债务人制度，指出三个法定要素均建立在规范性建构的输入之上，揭示了"虚构+倒置+默认"组合替代证据调查的制度风险，并提出采用中间证明标准（清晰且令人信服的证据）作为制度正当性的理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出四项操作性参数：将"不规则状态"的解读与国家税法典保持一致；结合支付能力解释已知资产；以税法典"arbitramento"模式下的合理推理间接评估取代零资产虚构；采用中间证明标准。这些建议为行政机关和法院提供了具体适用指引。

title: Anatomy of a Stalled Pivot: Federal Reserve Hawkishness, Central Bank Gold, and the Limits of De-dollarization
affiliations: Independent

detail.abstract: A thesis that only counts confirming evidence isn't a thesis. It's a scrapbook. This document exists because the falsification framework in Appendix B of the original thesis was supposed to mean something. Four months later, it's time to find out if it did.

AI.tldr: 本文是对原论文附录B中证伪框架的后续验证，反思原论文是否仅收集了证实性证据而缺乏真正的学术论证，类似于"剪贴簿"而非"论文"。
AI.research_question: 原论文附录B中的证伪框架在四个月后是否真正发挥了作用？原论文是否仅仅搜集了支持性证据而缺乏真正的证伪检验？
AI.motivation: 作者意识到原论文可能只是收集了证实性证据而非真正的学术论证，因此需要通过后续的证伪检验来验证原论文的理论框架是否真正有意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 证伪主义框架（Falsification framework），源自波普尔的科学哲学观点，强调学术研究必须包含可被证伪的检验而非仅收集支持性证据。
AI.method: 对原论文附录B中设定的证伪框架进行回溯性检验，评估其在实际研究中的执行情况和有效性。
AI.findings: 摘要未提供具体结果，但暗示作者将检验证伪框架是否真的被执行和具有意义，以确定原论文是否只是"剪贴簿"式的证据堆砌。
AI.theory_contributions: 强调学术论文必须包含证伪检验而非仅堆砌证实性证据，为学术方法论提供了反思性贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者提供了一种自我审视学术严谨性的范式，提醒研究者在论文完成后验证其理论框架的实际执行情况。

title: Digital Trade Commitments for a WTO Accession Candidate: Uzbekistan after the 2026 E-Commerce Moratorium Lapse

detail.title: Digital Trade Commitments for a WTO Accession Candidate: Uzbekistan after the 2026 E-Commerce Moratorium Lapse
detail.abstract: Uzbekistan is seeking to complete a WTO accession process that has remained open since 1994 at a moment of significant change in the governance of digital trade. The WTO moratorium on customs duties on electronic transmissions lapsed in March 2026, while a plurilateral Agreement on Electronic Commerce is moving forward through interim arrangements among members representing roughly 70 percent of global trade. This creates a problem that existing scholarship on WTO plurilateralism has not squarely addressed: how should an acceding country structure its terms of entry when digital trade rules are being made partly outside the multilateral consensus? This article argues that Uzbekistan should adopt a calibrated strategy of selective alignment. It should align early with the Agreement's relatively settled baseline provisions, including electronic signatures and authentication, electronic contracts, paperless trading, open government data, and the customs treatment of electronic transmissions, because these commitments support market access, administrative modernization, and predictability for digital services. At the same time, Uzbekistan should expressly reserve its position on less settled and more sovereignty-sensitive issues, including cross-border data flows, data localization, and source code disclosure. The paper concludes that Uzbekistan should bind digital openness only where legal and regulatory benefits are clear, while preserving policy space over data governance, cybersecurity, and digital industrial policy.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨乌兹别克斯坦在WTO加入进程中，面对数字贸易治理规则部分脱离多边共识的新形势，应如何设计入世条款。文章主张乌兹别克斯坦应采取"选择性对齐"的校准策略：对电子签名、电子合同、无纸化贸易、开放政府数据及电子传输关税等较成熟的基线条款尽早对齐；对跨境数据流动、数据本地化和源代码披露等主权敏感且尚未定型的问题明确保留立场，在绑定数字开放承诺时仅限法律与监管收益明确的领域，同时保留数据治理、网络安全和数字产业政策的政策空间。
AI.research_question: 在数字贸易规则部分在WTO多边共识之外制定的背景下，加入国（乌兹别克斯坦）应如何构建其入世条款？
AI.motivation: 乌兹别克斯坦自1994年以来一直寻求完成WTO入世进程，恰逢数字贸易治理发生重大变革：2026年3月WTO电子传输关税暂停令到期失效，同时一项涵盖全球约70%贸易的诸边《电子商务协定》正通过临时安排推进。现有关于WTO诸边主义的学术研究尚未直接回答：当数字贸易规则部分在多变共识之外制定时，加入国应如何安排入世条件？
AI.theoretical_framework: WTO诸边主义理论；选择性对齐（selective alignment）策略框架
AI.method: 规范性法律分析（normative legal analysis），基于对WTO电子商务协定条款状态和乌兹别克斯坦国情的制度分析
AI.findings: （1）乌兹别克斯坦应尽早对齐《电子商务协定》中相对成熟的基线条款，包括电子签名与认证、电子合同、无纸化贸易、开放政府数据和电子传输关税待遇，因为这些承诺有助于市场准入、行政现代化和数字服务可预见性；（2）乌兹别克斯坦应明确保留其在跨境数据流动、数据本地化和源代码披露等不太成熟且主权敏感问题上的立场；（3）乌兹别克斯坦应仅在法律和监管收益明确的领域绑定数字开放承诺，同时保留数据治理、网络安全和数字产业政策的政策空间。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了现有WTO诸边主义研究中对加入国条款设计问题的空白，提出了"选择性对齐"作为加入国在数字贸易规则碎片化背景下应对诸边协定的战略框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为乌兹别克斯坦及其他正在进行WTO入世谈判的发展中国家提供了具体的入世谈判策略指导，帮助其在数字贸易开放与维护数据主权、政策空间之间取得平衡。

title: The Last Signal Wins: How Recent Performance Information Shapes Subsequent Performance under Contradictory Signals
affiliations: University of Navarra - Business, Universidad de Navarra and University of Lausanne

detail.title: The Last Signal Wins: How Recent Performance Information Shapes Subsequent Performance under Contradictory Signals

declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the Spanish Ministry of Science and Innovation through the Knowledge Generation Projects programme [grant number PID2022-136451NB-I00].

detail.abstract: We extend research on relative performance information (RPI) by examining how individuals respond to recent performance signals when they receive contradictory RPI in highstakes settings. Drawing on recency theory, we predict that the latest signal carries greater weight in shaping motivation and behaviour. We test this prediction using professional bestof-three-set tennis matches that reach a deciding third set. We find that a recent positive signal is associated with better subsequent performance than a recent negative signal, even when both occur close in time. We further document substantial heterogeneity in this relationship, with RPI informativeness moderating the recency effect. Responses also differ by gender. The recency effect is attenuated among male players classified as Top Players-our proxy for higher self-efficacy-but persists among other male players and among female players. Responses also differ depending on whether recent RPI is positive or negative: women tend to underperform following unexpected positive signals, consistent with choking under pressure, whereas men respond more negatively to recent setbacks, consistent with the Golem effect. Overall, our findings highlight the importance of recency as a motivational dimension of performance information and show how individual characteristics and signal properties shape responses to and interpretations of recent performance signals.

AI.tldr: 本文基于近因理论，利用职业网球三盘两胜制比赛中进入决胜盘的数据，研究在高风险情境下个体如何回应矛盾的相对绩效信息（RPI）。研究发现近期积极信号比近期消极信号更能提升后续表现，且该近因效应受到RPI信息含量的调节，并存在显著的性别和自效能异质性。
AI.research_question: 当个体在高风险情境中收到矛盾的相对绩效信息时，近期绩效信号如何影响其动机和行为？
AI.motivation: 已有研究考察了相对绩效信息（RPI）对动机和行为的影响，但鲜有研究关注当RPI矛盾（同时包含积极和消极信号）时个体如何权衡不同信号，尤其是在高风险情境下的反应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 近因理论（Recency Theory）、自我效能理论、压力窒息效应（Choking under pressure）、Golem效应
AI.method: 利用职业网球三盘两胜制比赛中进入决胜第三盘的自然实验数据，进行实证分析，并结合异质性检验考察调节因素。
AI.findings: 1）近期积极信号比近期消极信号带来更好的后续表现，即使两者在时间上接近；2）RPI的信息含量会调节近因效应；3）男性顶级球员（自我效能更高的代理）中近因效应减弱，但其他男性和女性球员中持续存在；4）女性在意外积极信号后表现下滑（符合压力窒息），男性对近期挫折反应更消极（符合Golem效应）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将近因理论引入相对绩效信息研究，揭示近因性作为绩效信息的一个重要动机维度；同时细化了个体特征（性别、自我效能）和信号属性（信息含量、正负性质）如何共同塑造对绩效信息的解释与回应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者设计绩效反馈机制提供了启示：反馈的时序安排、信息含量以及接收者个体差异都应被纳入考虑，以优化激励效果；同时也为体育管理等领域提供了关于运动员在关键时刻心理状态与表现管理的实践指导。

title: Testing Nationesis: A Comparative Assessment of Regenerative Political Development in Finland, South Korea, Costa Rica, and Nigeria
affiliations: African Research Network (ARN)

detail.title: Testing Nationesis: A Comparative Assessment of Regenerative Political Development in Finland, South Korea, Costa Rica, and Nigeria
detail.abstract: The study of political development has traditionally been dominated by theories of state capacity, institutional quality, governance effectiveness, and resilience. These approaches have significantly improved scholarly understanding of why some countries achieve sustained economic growth, political stability, and institutional performance while others experience persistent fragility. However, the accelerating complexity of the twenty-first centuryincluding climate change, digital transformation, artificial intelligence, demographic transitions, geopolitical competition, and ecological disruption-has exposed important limitations in conventional governance paradigms. Effective institutions alone do not fully explain why certain political communities continuously adapt, innovate, and regenerate whereas others remain trapped in cycles of institutional stagnation despite repeated reforms. This article provides the first empirical assessment of the Theory of Nationesis through a comparative analysis of Finland, South Korea, Costa Rica, and Nigeria. These four countries represent contrasting trajectories of political evolution, ranging from highly regenerative governance systems to persistent developmental constraints. Using the Nationesis framework, the article examines eight interrelated dimensions of national regeneration: institutional regeneration, national political intelligence, innovation capacity, adaptive governance, social cohesion, economic transformation, ecological resilience, and symbolic legitimacy. Rather than treating political development as the accumulation of bureaucratic capacity, the study conceptualizes nations as complex adaptive systems whose long-term performance depends upon their ability to regenerate institutional, cognitive, social, and ecological capacities. The article argues that regenerative capacity provides a broader explanatory framework than state capacity alone and offers a new analytical perspective for comparative politics, governance studies, and development research. By empirically examining contrasting national trajectories, the study contributes to the emerging science of regenerative political development and establishes the empirical foundations of the Nationesis research programme.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对"国家再生理论"（Theory of Nationesis）进行实证评估，通过比较芬兰、韩国、哥斯达黎加和尼日利亚四个国家的政治发展轨迹，提出"再生能力"（regenerative capacity）作为超越传统国家能力理论的更广阔解释框架，从八个维度考察国家的长期再生表现。
AI.research_question: 为什么某些政治共同体能够持续适应、创新和再生，而另一些尽管经历反复改革仍陷入制度停滞？再生能力能否提供比国家能力更广阔的解释框架？
AI.motivation: 传统政治发展研究由"国家能力""制度质量""治理效能""韧性"等理论主导，但在21世纪面临气候变化、数字化转型、人工智能、人口转型、地缘竞争和生态危机等复杂挑战时，这些范式暴露了局限性——有效的制度无法充分解释为何某些政治共同体能持续再生而另一些陷入停滞。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国家再生理论（Theory of Nationesis），将国家视为复杂适应系统，强调其长期绩效取决于再生制度、认知、社会和生态能力的能力，而非仅仅官僚能力的积累。
AI.method: 比较分析方法，选取芬兰、韩国、哥斯达黎加和尼日利亚四个具有对比性政治演进轨迹的国家，运用国家再生框架考察八个相互关联的维度。
AI.findings: 再生能力比国家能力单独能够提供更广阔的解释框架；四个国家呈现出从高度再生的治理体系到持续发展约束的不同轨迹；国家再生理论能够为比较政治学、治理研究和发展研究提供新的分析视角。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次实证评估国家再生理论；将政治发展概念从官僚能力积累转向复杂适应系统的再生能力；为"再生性政治发展科学"提供理论基础并建立国家再生研究计划的实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国理解自身发展困境与优势提供新的比较分析框架；为政策制定者提供除国家能力之外的再生能力评估维度（制度再生、政治智能、创新能力、适应性治理、社会凝聚、经济转型、生态韧性和象征合法性）。

title: When the Law Meets the Wage Grid: Minimum Wages under Weak Enforcement in India
affiliations: Madras School of Economics, International Labour Organization (ILO) and The University of Manchester

detail.title: When the Law Meets the Wage Grid: Minimum Wages under Weak Enforcement in India
detail.abstract:
Reported pay for low-educated male casual workers in India concentrates on a grid of
round rupee values, while several hundred statutory minimum wages, revised annually
in small steps, mostly sit between grid points. We study how the legal line and the
wage grid interact, using a statutory panel of authority-industry-year minimum wages
matched to six Periodic Labour Force Survey rounds, with treatment the annual change
between consecutive 31 December snapshots, predating the survey window. Four results
follow. First, sixty per cent of casual wages sit within one per cent of multiples of
fifty; where the floor sits just below a round value, seventeen per cent are paid at the
round value and one per cent at the statute, replicated in the redesigned 2025 survey.
Second, floor increases raise measured sub-floor incidence by 0.57 to 0.84 per log point
while median and lower-tail wages do not respond; a first above-median increase raises
it by 16 points. Third, revisions that carry the floor across a round value raise strict
violation by nine points, nineteen near the crossed point, while parked mass and deeper
violation do not move. Fourth, among own-account workers, with no employer and no
minimum wage entitlement, the same increases raise sub-floor incidence by 6.5 points
while reported earnings and work intensity do not move. Statutory increases move
measured legal status more than wages; compliance statistics partly reflect where the
legal line sits on the grid, and our mechanical adjustment separates threshold reclassification
from change in the reported-pay distribution.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了印度低教育水平男性临时工报告的工资集中在整数值（如50卢比的倍数）网格上，而数百个法定最低工资标准（每年小幅修订）大多位于网格点之间的情况，探讨法定最低工资线与工资网格之间的交互作用。
AI.research_question: 法定最低工资线与工资报告网格如何交互？最低工资的上调是否真正影响工资水平，还是仅仅改变测量的法律合规状态？
AI.motivation: 工资报告集中在整数值网格上，而法定最低工资多位于网格点之间，导致合规统计可能反映的是法律线在网格上的位置而非实际工资变化，现有研究未充分考虑这种机械性效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工资网格理论（工资报告集中在整数值）、最低工资合规理论、阈值重新分类（threshold reclassification）理论
AI.method: 使用法定机构-行业-年份最低工资面板数据，匹配六轮定期劳动力调查（PLFS）数据，以连续12月31日快照之间的年度变化为处理变量，进行统计分析。
AI.findings: （1）60%的临时工工资处于50倍数1%以内；（2）最低工资上调使低于最低工资线的发生率每对数点增加0.57-0.84，但中位数和低尾工资不响应；（3）修订使最低工资跨越整数值时，严格违规率增加9个百分点，跨越点附近增加19个百分点，但停驻的聚集和更深的违规不变化；（4）在自有账户工人（无雇主、无最低工资资格）中同样增幅使低于最低工资线的发生率增加6.5个百分点，而报告收入和劳动强度不变。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了机械性调整方法，将阈值重新分类（法律线移动导致的分类变化）与报告工资分布的实质性变化区分开来，揭示了合规统计在多大程度上反映法律线在网格上的位置。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于最低工资合规统计的重新解读：法定最低工资上调更多反映在法律地位测量上而非实际工资变化；为合规监测提供了方法论改进，提示统计公布需考虑工资网格效应。

title: Stablecoins, Sovereignty, and Currency Competition

detail.title: Stablecoins, Sovereignty, and Currency Competition

declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by JST SPRING, Grant Number JPMJSP2108.

detail.abstract: This paper studies how fiat-pegged stablecoins reshape currency competition, seigniorage, and welfare in a Lagos-Wright economy. Stablecoin entry is modeled through the joint determination of sellers' currency acceptance and households' portfolio choices in decentralized trade, with buyers paying a per-transaction gas fee on stablecoin payments. The model yields three results. First, stablecoin acceptance lowers the valuation threshold of the domestic currency and narrows the inflation range over which domestic money circulates, with stronger displacement when the gas fee is low. The same logic extends to the anchor currency: for sufficiently small gas fees, the stablecoin can displace domestic residents' holdings of the pegged currency from valued equilibria. Second, stablecoin adoption shifts the domestic seigniorage Laffer curve downward by shrinking the domestic inflation-tax base. This erosion is mitigated by higher rival-currency inflation, larger gas fees, or greater local-currency exclusivity among sellers. Third, stablecoin entry can raise red-country welfare by integrating previously segmented trading opportunities, but red-country gains must be netted against both payment-fee outflows and stablecoin inflation-tax outflows. Numerical results reveal a trade-off between expanded market access and seigniorage loss, implying that inflation discipline and transaction-cost regulation both matter for preserving monetary sovereignty under stablecoin competition. A final extension endogenizes the gas fee as the payment infrastructure's average cost, creating a zero-adoption trap that eases as domestic inflation rises.

AI.tldr: 本文在Lagos-Wright货币搜索框架下研究法币锚定稳定币如何重塑货币竞争、铸币税与福利。研究结果表明：稳定币接受会降低本国货币的估值门槛并缩小其流通的通货膨胀区间；稳定币采用会使本国铸币税拉弗曲线下移；稳定币进入可通过整合分割的交易机会提升本国福利，但需扣除支付费用和稳定币通胀税流出。模型还内生化了gas费用，揭示了零采纳陷阱。
AI.research_question: 法币锚定稳定币如何影响货币竞争格局、铸币税收入和社会福利？
AI.motivation: 稳定币（如USDT、USDC）在全球范围内的快速扩张对主权货币体系和央行铸币税构成现实挑战，但缺乏一个统一的微观基础模型来系统分析稳定币进入如何通过买卖双方的互动决策影响货币竞争与福利分配。
AI.theoretical_framework: Lagos-Wright货币搜索模型；货币竞争理论；铸币税拉弗曲线理论；内生货币接受决策理论
AI.method: 理论建模（Lagos-Wright框架下的货币搜索模型），结合卖方货币接受决策与买方资产组合选择的联合确定，引入每笔交易的gas费用，并进行数值模拟分析。
AI.findings: （1）稳定币接受降低本国货币估值门槛并缩小国内货币流通的通胀区间，gas费用越低替代效应越强；当gas费用足够小时，稳定币可取代国内居民对锚定货币的持有。（2）稳定币采用通过缩小国内通胀税基使铸币税拉弗曲线下移，但竞争对手货币通胀上升、gas费用增加或本地货币排他性增强可缓解侵蚀。（3）稳定币进入可提升本国福利（通过整合分割交易），但需扣除支付费用流出和稳定币通胀税流出。（4）内生gas费用产生零采纳陷阱，国内通胀上升可缓解此陷阱。
AI.theory_contributions: 将稳定币纳入Lagos-Wright货币搜索框架，首次系统建模了稳定币进入对货币竞争的三重影响（估值门槛、铸币税基、福利分配）；内生化了支付基础设施成本（gas费用）对货币替代的影响；揭示了货币主权与稳定币竞争之间的理论权衡机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行和监管机构提供了稳定币竞争下的政策启示：通胀纪律（保持本币价格稳定）和交易成本监管（影响gas费用水平）对于维护货币主权至关重要；揭示了稳定币竞争下铸币税侵蚀的具体传导路径，有助于评估稳定币监管的福利影响。

title: A Heterogeneous Graph Transformer with Dose-Aware Cross-Layer Attention for Joint lncRNA-miRNA-Drug Resistance Association Prediction in Cancer

detail.title: A Heterogeneous Graph Transformer with Dose-Aware Cross-Layer Attention for Joint lncRNA-miRNA-Drug Resistance Association Prediction in Cancer
detail.abstract: Cancer drug resistance is increasingly understood to be mediated by long non-coding RNA (lncRNA) and microRNA (miRNA) regulatory networks, yet computational models typically treat lncRNA-drug and miRNA-drug resistance as separate, static prediction tasks. This paper proposes a Dose-Aware Heterogeneous Graph Transformer (HGT) that jointly models lncRNA, miRNA, and drug entities as a single heterogeneous graph, extending meta-relation-typed attention with a dose-conditioned gating mechanism and a cross-layer attention pooling module for interpretability. Because no real dataset was available in this working environment, the architecture is validated as a proof-of-concept (PoC) on a synthetic heterogeneous graph, implemented and trained from scratch in numpy (no GPU deep-learning framework was available), with manual backpropagation verified against numerical gradients. Two implementations are compared: a fixed-projection encoder with a trained prediction head, and a fully end-to-end trainable encoder. Both recover above-chance predictive signal (AUC 0.52-0.60), but a 5-seed replication with paired significance testing finds no statistically detectable benefit from dose-conditioning (p = 0.895) or cross-layer attention (p = 0.635) at this scale, a properly tested null result rather than an unresolved limitation. We report these results transparently, situate them against the closest published models (iNcRD-HG; MHGTMDA) via a qualitative comparative-positioning table, and specify the real-data validation required before the architecture's specific contributions can be properly evaluated.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种剂量感知的异构图Transformer（HGT），用于联合建模lncRNA、miRNA与药物实体之间的耐药性关系。由于工作环境中缺乏真实数据集，该架构仅在合成异构图数据集上作为概念验证（PoC）进行验证，使用numpy从零实现并进行了手动反向传播验证。结果表明模型能恢复高于随机水平的预测信号（AUC 0.52-0.60），但5次种子复制与配对显著性检验发现剂量条件门控（p=0.895）和跨层注意力（p=0.635）在统计上无显著收益，作者将此报告为经过恰当检验的零结果而非未解决的局限。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个联合建模lncRNA、miRNA与药物实体的异构图深度学习模型来预测癌症药物耐药性，并验证剂量条件门控与跨层注意力机制的增量贡献？
AI.motivation: 现有计算模型通常将lncRNA-药物和miRNA-药物的耐药性预测视为分离的静态任务，忽略了lncRNA-miRNA-药物之间的联合调控网络关系，且未考虑剂量因素对耐药性的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异构图Transformer（HGT）框架，结合元关系类型注意力（meta-relation-typed attention）、剂量条件门控机制（dose-conditioned gating）以及跨层注意力池化模块（cross-layer attention pooling）。
AI.method: 构建包含lncRNA、miRNA和药物三类实体的单一异构图；扩展元关系类型注意力并加入剂量条件门控机制；引入跨层注意力池化模块用于可解释性。使用numpy从零实现，手动反向传播与数值梯度对比验证正确性。比较固定投影编码器+预测头与端到端可训练编码器两种实现，并通过5次种子复制与配对显著性检验评估各模块的统计贡献。
AI.findings: 两种实现均能恢复高于随机的预测信号（AUC 0.52-0.60）；但配对显著性检验显示剂量条件门控（p=0.895）和跨层注意力（p=0.635）在当前规模下无统计学上可检测的增量收益，属于经恰当检验的零结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个统一的异构图框架将lncRNA-药物与miRNA-药物耐药性预测从分离任务整合为联合建模问题；引入剂量感知的门控机制与可解释性池化模块；通过严格的统计检验范式（多种子复制+配对检验）区分了"正效应"与"零结果"。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了基于numpy的纯CPU可复现实现方案，适用于无GPU环境；透明报告了零结果，为后续真实数据集验证提供了明确的测试协议与最接近的基线模型（iNcRD-HG、MHGTMDA）对比定位，明确了架构贡献在真实数据验证前不应被过度解读。

title: The Cyber Catastrophe Bond Premium: Sponsor Heterogeneity, Not Peril Learning
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Cyber Catastrophe Bond Premium: Sponsor Heterogeneity, Not Peril Learning
detail.abstract: The 144A cyber catastrophe bond market opened in November 2023 and by December 2025 had produced nine publicly priced indemnity tranches across three sponsors. Industry commentary interprets the 36 percent decline in average cyber multiples over this period as evidence that the novelty premium is fading through peril learning. Using a hand-collected panel of all nine cyber tranches alongside

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了2023年11月开启的144A网络巨灾债券市场，分析了截至2025年12月的九个公开定价的赔偿型分层（分属三个发起人）。研究发现网络倍数平均下降36%，行业评论将其解读为新奇溢价通过风险学习逐渐消退。
AI.research_question: 网络巨灾债券市场中，网络倍数下降36%是否确实反映新奇溢价消退，还是由其他因素驱动？
AI.motivation: 网络巨灾债券市场是新兴市场，行业解读认为倍数下降源于风险学习，但需要严谨的实证分析来验证这一解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新奇溢价与风险学习理论
AI.method: 手工收集面板数据，分析九个网络巨灾债券分层
AI.findings: 网络倍数自市场开启以来平均下降36%
AI.theory_contributions: 对新奇溢价消退机制提供实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为网络巨灾债券市场的定价和投资者决策提供参考

title: Regime Shift and the Limits of Supervised Meta-labelling: Ensemble Signal Filtering on Multi-asset Futures
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Regime Shift and the Limits of Supervised Meta-labelling: Ensemble Signal Filtering on Multi-asset Futures
detail.abstract: This paper constructs a supervised metamodel that filters a primary directional trading signal across eleven equity, energy, and metals futures contracts using 24 years of daily data (1990-2022). The pipeline combines STFT-CVAE-GMM-HMM regime detection, 91 engineered features including TF-C self-supervised embeddings, triple-barrier labelling with four parallel volatility estimators, and an

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个监督式元模型，利用1990-2022年24年的日度数据，对11个股票、能源和金属期货合约的主方向性交易信号进行过滤。该管道结合了STFT-CVAE-GMM-HMM状态检测、91个工程特征（包括TF-C自监督嵌入）、三重障碍标注与四个并行波动率估计器。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个监督式元模型来有效过滤跨多资产类别（股票、能源、金属）期货合约的主方向性交易信号，以提高交易策略的表现？
AI.motivation: 方向性交易信号往往包含噪声和虚假信号，需要一种系统化的元模型方法来过滤无效信号，并验证该方法在多个资产类别上的泛化能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究基于深度学习与信号处理的理论框架，包括短时傅里叶变换（STFT）、条件变分自编码器（CVAE）、高斯混合模型（GMM）、隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）以及时间-频率对比学习（TF-C）自监督学习等理论。
AI.method: 研究采用多层管道方法：(1) STFT-CVAE-GMM-HMM进行状态检测；(2) 91个工程特征（含TF-C自监督嵌入）；(3) 三重障碍标注与四个并行波动率估计器；(4) 监督式元模型对主信号进行过滤。
AI.findings: 摘要未完整显示具体结果，但研究通过24年数据和11个期货合约验证了该元模型过滤方法的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 该研究为交易信号过滤提供了综合性的理论框架，整合了状态检测、自监督特征学习和多波动率估计等多维方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为量化交易实践提供了一种可跨多资产类别部署的信号过滤管道，提升交易信号的可靠性和策略稳定性。

title: Marriage and Gender-based Labor Market Outcomes
affiliations: University of Newcastle and

detail.title: Marriage and Gender-based Labor Market Outcomes
detail.abstract: This paper explores how the interaction of labor and marriage markets can generate observed differences in outcomes across genders. The framework comprises simultaneous frictional markets with ex ante identical workers within and across genders. Gendered outcomes emerge because firms coordinate on paying men more than women. The latter then quit upon marriage supporting statistical wage discrimination. Marriage-wage premia, differentiated attachment to the labor market, and gender-specific impact of wages on marriage rates also endogenously emerge across multiple equilibrium types. Looking across coexistent equilibria, simulations show that as gender wage differentials decrease marriage-wage premia increase-the more a woman earns the more she expects of any prospective husband.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建劳动力市场与婚姻市场同时摩擦的双市场均衡模型，解释了性别间结果差异的成因。模型假设所有工人在性别内外都是事前相同的，但企业协调性地支付男性高于女性的工资，女性在婚后选择辞职，从而支持了统计性工资歧视。模型内生地产生了婚姻工资溢价、劳动力市场依附差异以及工资对婚姻率的性别差异化影响。跨均衡模拟表明，性别工资差距缩小会导致婚姻溢价上升——女性收入越高，对未来丈夫的期望也越高。
AI.research_question: 劳动力市场与婚姻市场的相互作用如何内生地产生性别间的结果差异？
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常将劳动力市场与婚姻市场分开分析，而性别间的结果差异（如工资差距、婚姻溢价）可能源于两个市场的相互作用。作者希望通过一个统一框架解释这些看似独立的性别差异现象如何内生涌现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 同时摩擦的双市场均衡理论；统计性工资歧视理论；搜寻匹配理论
AI.method: 构建劳动力与婚姻市场同时摩擦的理论模型，通过多均衡类型分析及计算机模拟进行数值验证。
AI.findings: （1）即使工人在事前完全相同，企业协调性支付男性更高工资后，女性婚后辞职行为会支持统计性工资歧视；（2）婚姻工资溢价、劳动力市场性别依附差异、工资对婚姻率的性别差异化影响均为内生涌现的结果，存在于多种均衡类型中；（3）跨共存均衡的模拟显示，性别工资差距越小，婚姻工资溢价越大——女性收入越高对潜在配偶的期望越高。
AI.theory_contributions: 将劳动力市场与婚姻市场整合进统一框架，揭示了两个市场相互作用如何产生统计性歧视的自我实现机制；解释了婚姻工资溢价和性别工资差距的内生性来源。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解性别工资差距的持续性与婚姻决策的联动提供了政策启示，表明缩小性别工资差距可能带来婚姻期望的变化，需综合考量两个市场的政策效果。

title: Market Diffusion of Distributed Photovoltaics Incorporating Uncertainties and Behavioral Interactions
affiliations: Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing Institute of Technology, China University of Petroleum (Beijing) and Beijing Institute of Technology

detail.title: Market Diffusion of Distributed Photovoltaics Incorporating Uncertainties and Behavioral Interactions
detail.abstract: Promoting the diffusion of distributed photovoltaics (DPV) is crucial for China’s low-carbon transition. Yet existing studies overlook the joint effects of multidimensional uncertainties, behavioral interactions, and agent heterogeneity on adoption dynamics. This study constructs a multi-agent evolutionary model coupled with social network analysis (SNA) to simulate DPV market adoption in China from 2026 to 2060. The model endogenizes the uncertainties of technological progress and climate change, and classifies potential adopters into four heterogeneous agent types: urban residential, public, industrial, and rural buildings. By embedding an SNA framework, the simulation captures behavioral interactions and dynamic state updates among these agents, revealing how multidimensional uncertainties shape micro-level diffusion processes. Results indicate that: (1) Multidimensional uncertainties reshape DPV trajectories asymmetrically. Under the baseline scenario, cumulative capacity reaches 2,440 GW by 2060. Climate risks suppress this to 1,457 GW (40% below baseline), exceeding the inhibitory effect of technological stagnation (1,634 GW, 33% below), as physical damage combined with network-propagated negative sentiment constrains adoption more than slow cost reduction. (2) Adoption behaviors exhibit profound structural heterogeneity. The urban-residential sector shows extreme risk-elasticity, with capacity plummeting by nearly 50% under climate risks. In contrast, industrial buildings demonstrate strong adoption rigidity, declining by only 10%. (3) Targeted interventions disrupt risk contagion effectively: insurance mechanisms enable the residential sector to recover nearly 80% of its climate-induced capacity loss, and synergistic policy incentives offset most hesitance from technological stagnation.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个结合社会网络分析（SNA）的多智能体演化模型，模拟2026-2060年中国分布式光伏（DPV）市场扩散过程，综合考虑技术进步和气候变化的多维不确定性、行为交互及异质性主体的联合影响。研究发现气候风险比技术停滞更能抑制DPV扩散，不同建筑类型表现出深刻的结构异质性，且靶向干预（保险机制和协同政策激励）能有效缓解风险传染和采纳犹豫。
AI.research_question: 多维不确定性、行为交互和主体异质性如何联合影响中国分布式光伏的市场采纳动态？
AI.motivation: 分布式光伏对中国低碳转型至关重要，但现有研究忽视了多维不确定性、行为交互和主体异质性对采纳动态的联合影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多智能体演化模型（multi-agent evolutionary model）、社会网络分析（SNA）、技术创新扩散理论、行为决策理论
AI.method: 构建多智能体演化模型并耦合社会网络分析框架，内生技术进步和气候变化的不确定性，将潜在采纳者分为城市住宅、公共建筑、工业和农村建筑四类异质性主体，通过仿真模拟捕捉行为交互和动态状态更新过程。
AI.findings: (1)基准情景下2060年累计装机容量达2,440 GW；气候风险将其抑制至1,457 GW（低于基准40%），超过技术停滞的抑制效应（1,634 GW，低于33%）；(2)城市住宅部门对风险极度敏感（气候风险下容量下降近50%），而工业建筑表现出强采纳刚性（仅下降10%）；(3)保险机制可使住宅部门恢复约80%的气候损失，协同政策激励可抵消大部分技术停滞带来的犹豫。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将多维不确定性、行为交互和主体异质性纳入统一框架研究DPV扩散动态，揭示了气候风险的物理损害与网络传播的负面情绪对采纳的联合抑制作用超过技术成本下降缓慢的影响，丰富了分布式光伏扩散与低碳转型理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了靶向干预策略（保险机制、协同政策激励）的设计依据，有助于精准识别高风险敏感群体并制定差异化推广政策，促进中国分布式光伏市场健康有序发展。

title: Intertemporal Return Contracts for Electricity Investment: A Feasibility Analysis Under Divergent Discount Rates
affiliations: , Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), Government of the United States of America - Argonne National Laboratory and Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)

detail.title: Intertemporal Return Contracts for Electricity Investment: A Feasibility Analysis Under Divergent Discount Rates
detail.abstract:
In many electricity markets, private firms are expected to make investments that support public objectives such as decarbonization and security of supply. However, some projects with public value may not be investable under private actors’ required rates of return. Differences in public and private discount rates contribute to this gap because each actor values future outcomes differently. This paper proposes an intertemporal return contract that pairs upfront public support with future monetary value returned through electricity price reductions or repayments. A stylized project level feasibility model evaluates this contract for a private investor and a public actor. The model identifies combinations of upfront support and future price reductions that preserve private investability while keeping the public actor’s levelized cost below a benchmark electricity price.

Under the stylized assumptions, the proposed contract can satisfy both private and public feasibility conditions. The private actor places greater value on earlier support, while the public actor places relatively greater value on future price reductions under a lower discount rate. The modeling produces a feasible contract space, rather than just a single contract, showing which combinations satisfy both conditions. The feasible space is larger for the capital-intensive, long lifetime project than for the shorter lifetime project. Longer operating periods provide more years for future price reductions to return value to the public actor, while shorter lifetime projects have less room to offset upfront support. Ultimately, these contracts may be useful when public support is justified and policymakers want a mechanism for returning monetary value to consumers or public funding pools. An explicit return mechanism may also strengthen the policy case for support by making the public benefit direct and contractually bound.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种跨期回报合同（intertemporal return contract），将前期公共支持与未来通过电价降低或还款返还的货币价值相结合，以解决私人投资者因贴现率差异而不愿投资具有公共价值项目的问题。通过构建项目层面的可行性模型，识别出既能保持私人可投资性又能使公共方平准化成本低于基准电价的合同组合空间。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种合同机制，使具有公共价值但私人投资回报率不足的项目（如脱碳和供电安全项目）既能满足私人投资者的可投资性要求，又能确保公共方获得合理的价值回报？
AI.motivation: 在许多电力市场中，私人公司被期望投资支持公共目标（如脱碳和供电安全）的项目，但一些具有公共价值的项目在私人行动者要求的回报率下可能不具备可投资性。公共和私人贴现率的差异导致这一差距，因为每个行动者对未来结果的估值不同。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贴现率差异理论（公共与私人贴现率的不同导致对远期价值的评估差异）；跨期合同设计理论
AI.method: 构建风格化的项目层面可行性模型（stylized project-level feasibility model），评估跨期回报合同对私人投资者和公共行动者的影响，识别满足双方可行性条件的合同组合空间。
AI.findings: （1）所提出的合同可以同时满足私人和公共可行性条件；（2）私人行动者更看重早期支持，而公共行动者在较低贴现率下更看重未来电价下降；（3）模型产生的是一个可行合同空间而非单一合同；（4）资本密集型、长寿命项目的可行空间大于短寿命项目，因为更长的运营期提供了更多年份让未来电价降低向公共方返还价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 将公共与私人贴现率差异理论应用于电力市场合同设计，提出了一种通过时间维度上的价值交换（前期支持换未来回报）来弥合公共与私人投资可行性差距的理论框架，并展示了不同项目特征（资本密集度、寿命）如何影响可行合同空间的大小。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了一种新的合同机制，使公共支持具有明确的回报机制（通过电价降低或还款），增强公共利益的直接性和合同约束力；有助于在公共支持合理的场景下，为消费者或公共资金池返还货币价值提供政策工具。

title: Fiscal Multipliers during Natural Disasters
affiliations: , Catholic University of Milan and Banque de France

detail.title: Fiscal Multipliers during Natural Disasters
detail.abstract: Fiscal multipliers are larger during natural disasters. Using aggregate and state-level U.S. data, we show that the government-spending multiplier is significantly magnified when natural disasters occur. To rationalize this finding, we develop a New-Keynesian model augmented with disaster risk, in which higher public spending generates a larger output expansion through a strengthened investment channel. Two mechanisms are at work. First, by destroying productive capacity, a disaster raises the marginal productivity of capital, which further crowds in private investment. Second, wealth destruction leads households to draw down less of their savings in response to the fiscal shock, which boosts capital supply.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国总量和州级数据，发现自然灾害期间财政乘数显著放大。作者构建了一个包含灾难风险的新凯恩斯模型来解释这一现象，其核心机制在于：灾害通过提高资本边际生产率吸引更多私人投资，同时财富破坏使家庭减少储蓄提取，从而增加资本供给，双重渠道共同强化了财政支出的产出扩张效应。
AI.research_question: 自然灾害期间政府支出乘数是否以及为何会被放大？其背后的经济机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 既有文献对财政乘数的估计差异较大，但鲜有研究系统考察自然灾害这一特殊背景下财政乘数的变化。由于灾难期间政府往往需要大规模支出进行灾后重建与救助，理解此时财政乘数的动态特征对政策制定具有重要现实意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新凯恩斯主义模型（New-Keynesian Model），并引入灾难风险（disaster risk）作为模型扩展维度。
AI.method: 使用美国总量数据和州级数据进行实证分析，并结合包含灾难风险的新凯恩斯主义DSGE模型进行理论建模与机制验证。
AI.findings: 自然灾难期间政府支出乘数显著放大。两条机制驱动：（1）灾害破坏生产能力，提升资本边际生产率，从而挤入私人投资；（2）财富破坏使家庭在财政冲击下减少储蓄提取，增加资本供给。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统地将自然灾害与财政乘数联系起来，构建了包含灾难风险的新凯恩斯模型，揭示了灾害情境下财政政策传导的独特机制（投资渠道的强化），丰富了财政乘数理论和灾难经济学的交叉研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府在自然灾害时期实施扩张性财政政策提供了理论依据和量化证据，表明灾后财政支出的产出效应更为显著，有助于指导灾后重建与财政资源配置的决策。

title: DECODEM: Data Extraction from Corporate Organizational Documents via Enhanced Methods
affiliations: Washington University in St. Louis - School of Law

detail.title: DECODEM: Data Extraction from Corporate Organizational Documents via Enhanced Methods
detail.abstract:
Much empirical legal research depends on translating unstructured text into structured variables. In corporate governance research as elsewhere, this translation has traditionally relied on human coding of documents such as charters and bylaws, a process that is costly, difficult to scale, and often opaque. This paper introduces DECODEM, a set of benchmark datasets for evaluating the automated extraction of corporate governance variables from organizational documents. The benchmarks pair randomly sampled corporate charters and bylaws with high-quality human annotations covering a range of governance provisions commonly studied in empirical work. 

Using these datasets, the paper evaluates several largelanguage-model extraction pipelines that vary in prompt design, task decomposition, and document handling. The underlying task consists of a set of document-level binary classification problems, one for each governance variable.
